description: This file defines a utility class 'Assert' with static methods for argument validation, including null checks, type checks, and emptiness checks, used for enforcing preconditions in Java code.

classes.name: Assert
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for argument validation, including null checks, type assertions, and emptiness checks.

methods.description: Checks if an argument is not an instance of any of the specified classes.
